description: This file defines the SoftnetStat struct and functions to read and parse data from /proc/net/softnet_stat, including handling different Linux kernel versions.

methods.name: NetSoftnetStat
methods.description: Reads and parses data from /proc/net/softnet_stat, returning a slice of SoftnetStat.

methods.name: parseSoftnet
methods.description: Parses the content of /proc/net/softnet_stat into a slice of SoftnetStat, handling different kernel versions.

methods.name: parseHexUint32s
methods.description: Converts a slice of hexadecimal string representations into a slice of uint32.
